description: Rewrite text to remove AI-writing tells. POST prose and get it back with the mechanical tells fixed (AI vocabulary swapped for plain words, filler phrases stripped, em-dash overuse reduced, significance inflation deflated) plus a change log, before/after ai-ness scores, and a residual list of tells that need human judgment (not auto-rewritten). Code fences, inline code, URLs, and quotes are never touched. Deterministic, no LLM. Sister to humanizer_score (the detector).

text.description: The prose to rewrite (up to 100k chars).

name: humanize
